zh.text: Travelers 首席財務官 Daniel Frey 表示，本季度利率大幅上升導致稅後淨未實現投資虧損從 6 月 30 日的 20 億美元增至 9 月 30 日的 64 億美元，並強調未實現虧損由利率驅動，而非信用品質問題。$TRV

en.text: Travelers CFO Daniel Frey stated that the significant increase in interest rates during the quarter increased the net unrealized investment loss from $2 billion after tax at June 30 to $6.4 billion after tax at September 30, emphasizing the unrealized loss is interest rate driven, not credit quality driven. $TRV

zh.text: 烏幹達10月通脹率為5.8%，高於其 5.0%/年的目標。貨幣供應量（M3）年增長18.4%，高於漢克的黃金增長率13.9%/年（與 5%通脹目標一致）。通脹故事就是貨幣供應故事。

en.text: Uganda's inflation came in at 5.8% in October, above its target of 5.0%/yr. Money supply (M3) is growing at 18.4%/yr, above Hanke's Golden Growth Rate of 13.9%/yr consistent with the 5% target. Inflation story is a money supply story.

zh.text: 另一個大週即將到來，包括就業報告以及 $AAPL、$PLTR、$AMD、$ARM、$QCOM 等財報。週一早上可獲取預覽：https://t3live.com/rd。（@RedDogT3）

en.text: Another monster week is coming with the jobs report + $AAPL $PLTR $AMD $ARM $QCOM earnings and more. Get preview on Monday morning at https://t3live.com/rd. By @RedDogT3.

zh.text: JPM表示AI資本支出將從2027年的9000億美元上升至1.5-2萬億美元。當前週期並非類似於互聯網泡沫時期，當時投機性投資跑在需求前面。

en.text: JPM says AI capex to rise from $900B to $1.5-2T in '27. The current cycle is NOT analogous to the dot-com boom, when speculative investment ran ahead of demand.

zh.text: 是的。在新興市場你只會有貨幣貶值。歐元區通過這些TARGET2流量延遲了那次貶值。最簡單的方式是想象TARGET2歸零會發生什麼。這將要求ECB出售其所有主權債務持倉。債息將急昇，我們將陷入大危機。

en.text: Yes. In EM you would have just had a currency devaluation. The Euro zone has delayed that devaluation with these TARGET2 flows. Easiest way to see this is to think what would happen if TARGET2 goes to zero. It would require the ECB to sell all its sovereign debt holdings. Yields would spike and we’d be in a big crisis.

zh.text: 不。德國的TARGET2債權基本上是高債務外圍國家人為債息上限及貨幣大幅高估的對應物。這無法輕算消。若沒有這些債權，外圍貨幣已經大幅貶值，當然它們有一天仍可能這樣做…

en.text: No. Germany’s TARGET2 claims are basically the counterpart to artificial yield caps and big currency overvaluations on the high-debt periphery. There is no netting this out. Without these claims, periphery currencies would have devalued massively and of course they still might one day…

zh.text: 美元、利率和油價全都在上升…這三者都緊縮金融條件，從而帶動流動性，再帶動市場。加密貨幣需要這三者消散。中期選舉即將到來，特朗普希望油價、利率和美元下降。油價可能通過伊朗解決方案完成…這將重新點燃風險承受能力並把資本帶回市場。

en.text: Dollar, rates and oil all going up... all three tighten financial conditions, which leads liquidity, which leads markets. Crypto needs those three to dissipate. Coming into the midterms Trump wants oil, rates and the dollar down. Oil probably gets done via an Iran resolution... Thats what reignites the ability to take risk and brings capital back into markets.

zh.text: $SPY出現大缺口後回落，現低於除了20日均線外的所有均線。下方有小缺口及更低缺口可帶來至200日均線。中期選舉、伊朗及更多盈利需關注。200日均線觸及可能是關鍵位。

en.text: $SPY big gap and crap, under all the MA's now but the 20D. Small gap below and a gap lower that would bring us to the 200D. Midterms/Iran and more earnings on watch. 200D touch could be the spot.

zh.text: Doug Kass在過去兩年在@TheStreetPro撰寫267篇《More Tales From Nvidia》專欄。表達與Roger McNamee相同的擔憂：社會未為AI負面後果做好準備；創造者回避責任；AI現實未達預期且企業客戶付費不足；大型語言模型限制與機率誤差即使擴張仍存在；大規模整合成本及債務融資的AI投資造成時間風險與通臀壓力，情況比互聯網時代更糟；只有少數AI公司可能成功，風險是數百億美元撥銷；$CRWV（空頭）與$ORCL（空頭）已處困境，資產負債表延長並有離岸融資。其他風險包括欺詐、網絡安全、技能下降與權力集中。並連結McNamee關於AI金融泡沫的文章。

en.text: Doug Kass has written 267 columns (More Tales From Nvidia) on @TheStreetPro over two years. Expresses concerns shared with Roger McNamee: society ill-prepared for AI risks; creators evade accountability; AI falls short of expectations with few paying enterprise customers; LLM limitations and errors persist despite scaling; massive integration costs and debt-financed AI investment create timing risks and inflationary pressure worse than internet era; only few AI firms likely succeed risking hundreds of billions in writeoffs; $CRWV (short) and $ORCL (short) already distressed with extended balance sheets and offshore financing. Other risks include fraud, cybersecurity, deskilling and power concentration. Links McNamee article on AI financial bubble.
